about: 0.60: gathers every spoken line of the game from the scripts into game/assets/audio/voices/dialogue.json.

lines.speaker: Jonna
lines.text: Salamat sa Diyos. You're real. When the shooting stopped I prayed it was you out there and not them.
lines.tts: [shaky, close to tears] Salamat sa Diyos... you're real. [exhales] When the shooting stopped, I prayed it was you out there... and not them.

lines.speaker: Alex
lines.text: You're hurt. What happened here?
lines.tts: [concerned] You're hurt. What happened here?

lines.speaker: Aljay
lines.text: You're hurt. What happened here?
lines.tts: [concerned] You're hurt. What happened here?

lines.speaker: Jonna
lines.text: Three nights ago it was only the news. A fight at Bankerohan market, people biting. By morning the barangay was ringing the bell and nobody knew why.
lines.tts: [tired, haunted] Three nights ago, it was only the news. A fight at Bankerohan market... people biting. By morning the barangay was ringing the bell, and nobody knew why.

lines.speaker: Jonna
lines.text: Then it was everywhere at once. The ambulances stopped coming. The soldiers came in yesterday and made the mart their supply point. They held that door all night.
lines.tts: Then it was everywhere. At once. The ambulances stopped coming. The soldiers came in yesterday, made the mart their supply point... [quietly] They held that door all night.

lines.speaker: Jonna
lines.text: When the front glass went they pushed the customers to the back. I got this door shut. The others... I heard them. I could not open it.
lines.tts: When the front glass went, they pushed the customers to the back. I got this door shut. The others... [voice breaking] I heard them. I could not open it.

lines.speaker: Alex
lines.text: Let me look at that.
lines.tts: [gently] Let me look at that.

lines.speaker: Aljay
lines.text: Let me look at that.

lines.speaker: Louie
lines.text: Let me look at that.

lines.speaker: Clyde
lines.text: Let me look at that.
lines.tts: [gently] Let me look at that.

lines.speaker: Jonna
lines.text: Leave it. It's the fridge glass, not a bite. I tied it off. If I stand too long the room turns, that's all.
lines.tts: [pained, waving it off] Leave it. It's the fridge glass, not a bite! I tied it off. If I stand too long, the room turns... that's all.

lines.speaker: Jonna
lines.text: Listen to me. That radio on the desk. Last night someone came on the barangay channel, a teacher. There are survivors at the college up north, the Prof. Ivan Lawrence College, five hundred metres from here. The gates are shut. They have water and a generator.
lines.tts: [urgent] Listen to me. That radio, on the desk. Last night someone came on the barangay channel... a teacher. There are survivors at the college up north, the Prof. Ivan Lawrence College. Five hundred metres from here. The gates are shut. They have water, and a generator.

lines.speaker: Alex
lines.text: Then we take the main road. It runs straight there.
lines.tts: Then we take the main road. It runs straight there.

lines.speaker: Aljay
lines.text: Then we take the main road. It runs straight there.
lines.tts: Then we take the main road. It runs straight there.

lines.tts: Then we take the main road. It runs straight there.

lines.speaker: Clyde
lines.text: Then we take the main road. It runs straight there.
lines.tts: Then we take the main road. It runs straight there.

lines.speaker: Jonna
lines.text: No. The main road is finished. Cars on top of cars, fires, and them, hundreds of them. You won't drive it and you won't walk it.
lines.tts: [firmly] No. No! The main road is finished. Cars on top of cars, fires... and them. Hundreds of them. You won't drive it, and you won't walk it.

lines.speaker: Jonna
lines.text: Go out the back. The service gate opens on the old backstreets behind the shops: the pawnshop, the bakery, the Avenida arcade. They're narrow, but they run all the way to the school's back gate.
lines.tts: Go out the back. The service gate opens on the old backstreets behind the shops. The pawnshop, the bakery, the Avenida arcade. They're narrow... but they run all the way to the school's back gate.

lines.speaker: Alex
lines.text: Come with us.
lines.tts: [pleading] Come with us.

lines.speaker: Aljay
lines.text: Come with us.
lines.tts: [pleading] Come with us.

lines.speaker: Louie
lines.text: Come with us.
lines.tts: [pleading] Come with us.

lines.speaker: Anthony
lines.text: Come with us.
lines.tts: [pleading] Come with us.

lines.speaker: Clyde
lines.text: Come with us.
lines.tts: [pleading] Come with us.

lines.speaker: Jonna
lines.text: I would slow you down and you know it. Lock this door behind you. If the radio comes back I'll tell them you're coming. Go, before the night gets any older.
lines.tts: [sad smile] I would slow you down, and you know it. Lock this door behind you. If the radio comes back, I'll tell them you're coming. [softly] Go... before the night gets any older.

lines.speaker: Rommel
lines.text: You came through the backstreets? Diyos ko... I thought the whole city was gone.
lines.tts: [stunned, weak] You came through the backstreets? Diyos ko... [shaky laugh] I thought the whole city was gone.

lines.speaker: Alex
lines.text: You're hurt. Who are you?
lines.tts: [cautious] You're hurt. Who are you?

lines.speaker: Aljay
lines.text: You're hurt. Who are you?

lines.speaker: Rommel
lines.text: Rommel. Night guard. Eleven years on this gate. Sir Ivan hired me himself.
lines.tts: [tired, a little proud] Rommel. Night guard. Eleven years on this gate. Sir Ivan hired me himself.

lines.speaker: Rommel
lines.text: When it started he told me: nobody in, nobody out, until the ambulances come. So I locked it. I locked it with four thousand kids inside.
lines.tts: When it started, he told me: nobody in, nobody out, until the ambulances come. So I locked it. [voice breaking] I locked it... with four thousand kids inside.

lines.speaker: Alex
lines.text: Is anyone still alive in there?
lines.tts: [hopeful, tense] Is anyone still alive in there?

lines.speaker: Aljay
lines.text: Is anyone still alive in there?
lines.tts: [hopeful, tense] Is anyone still alive in there?

lines.text: Is anyone still alive in there?

lines.text: Is anyone still alive in there?
lines.tts: [hopeful, tense] Is anyone still alive in there?

lines.speaker: Clyde
lines.text: Is anyone still alive in there?
lines.tts: [hopeful, tense] Is anyone still alive in there?

lines.speaker: Rommel
lines.text: The fifth floor. Last night a light came on in a classroom up there, west side. Someone flashed it three times. They're waiting for someone.
lines.tts: [looking up, hopeful] The fifth floor. Last night a light came on in a classroom up there, west side. Someone flashed it. Three times. They're waiting for someone.

lines.speaker: Rommel
lines.text: I tried to go up. The kids piled their desks into the stairs to stop the others following them. Only one way is open from each floor. You'll have to cross every floor to find it.
lines.tts: [frustrated] I tried to go up. The kids piled their desks into the stairs, to stop the others following them. Only one way is open from each floor. You'll have to cross every floor to find it.

lines.speaker: Alex
lines.text: And Sir Ivan?
lines.tts: [hesitant] And Sir Ivan?

lines.speaker: Aljay
lines.text: And Sir Ivan?
lines.tts: [hesitant] And Sir Ivan?

lines.speaker: Louie
lines.text: And Sir Ivan?
lines.tts: [hesitant] And Sir Ivan?

lines.speaker: Anthony
lines.text: And Sir Ivan?
lines.tts: [hesitant] And Sir Ivan?

lines.speaker: Clyde
lines.text: And Sir Ivan?
lines.tts: [hesitant] And Sir Ivan?

lines.speaker: Rommel
lines.text: He went up after them the first night, with a fire extinguisher and his keys. He never came down.
lines.tts: [quietly, grieving] He went up after them the first night... with a fire extinguisher and his keys. [pause] He never came down.

lines.speaker: Rommel
lines.text: They're not sick anymore, the students. They're fast, and they don't stop. Don't let them follow you up the stairs.
lines.tts: [grim warning] They're not sick anymore, the students. They're fast. And they don't stop. Don't let them follow you up the stairs.

lines.speaker: Rommel
lines.text: Look at my arm. You know what this is. I'll hold the gate behind you for as long as I'm still me. Please. Bring those children out.
lines.tts: [bitter laugh] Look at my arm. You know what this is. [steady] I'll hold the gate behind you... for as long as I'm still me. [pleading] Please. Bring those children out.

lines.speaker: Ma'am Teves
lines.text: Diyos ko... you're real. You're not from the barangay. Who sent you?
lines.tts: [trembling, disbelieving] Diyos ko... you're real. [wary] You're not from the barangay. Who sent you?

lines.speaker: Alex
lines.text: Rommel, at the back gate. He said someone up here flashes a light every night.
lines.tts: Rommel... at the back gate. He said someone up here flashes a light every night.

lines.text: Rommel, at the back gate. He said someone up here flashes a light every night.
lines.tts: Rommel... at the back gate. He said someone up here flashes a light every night.

lines.speaker: Ma'am Teves
lines.text: That was me. Three times, every night. Eleven of us came up here the first night. Some went down to find their parents. Five of us are left.
lines.tts: That was me. Three times, every night. Eleven of us came up here the first night. Some went down to find their parents. [voice cracking] Five of us are left.

lines.speaker: Ma'am Teves
lines.text: Bea, Paolo, Jerome, Trisha. Up. Get your bags. These people are taking us out.
lines.tts: [firm teacher's voice] Bea, Paolo, Jerome, Trisha. Up! Get your bags. These people are taking us out.

lines.speaker: Ma'am Teves
lines.text: He brought us water on the second night, through the ceiling. He went back down for the others. We heard him on the stairs. Then we didn't.
lines.tts: [sadly] He brought us water on the second night, through the ceiling. He went back down for the others. We heard him on the stairs. [long pause] Then we didn't.

lines.speaker: Ma'am Teves
lines.text: Listen to me. At this hour they come through. All of them. Up the east stairs and along this hall, every night, like the bell still rings for them.
lines.tts: [urgent, low] Listen to me. At this hour, they come through. All of them. Up the east stairs and along this hall, every night... like the bell still rings for them.

lines.speaker: Ma'am Teves
lines.text: Every light off. Everyone inside, away from the door, and nobody moves until they've gone past. Not a sound. Please.
lines.tts: Every light off. Everyone inside, away from the door, and nobody moves until they've gone past. Not a sound. [begging] Please.

lines.speaker: Ma'am Teves
lines.text: They've stopped. They won't go now. Not until it's light.
lines.tts: [whispers, afraid] They've stopped. They won't go now... Not until it's light.

lines.speaker: Ma'am Teves
lines.text: Hear that, in the ceiling? They're in the vent. The way you came is full of them.
lines.tts: [whispers] Hear that? In the ceiling? [shaky whisper] They're in the vent. The way you came is full of them.

lines.speaker: Ma'am Teves
lines.text: The fire exit, at the far end of this hall. We chained it ourselves the first night. Here, the key. Slowly. Lights off. If anyone fires, all of them come.
lines.tts: [whispers] The fire exit, at the far end of this hall. We chained it ourselves, the first night. Here... the key. Slowly. Lights off. [tense whisper] If anyone fires, all of them come.

lines.speaker: Alex
lines.text: Wait. There's someone by the gate. Sitting there.
lines.tts: [whispers, alarmed] Wait. There's someone by the gate. Sitting there.

lines.text: Wait. There's someone by the gate. Sitting there.
lines.tts: [whispers, alarmed] Wait. There's someone by the gate. Sitting there.

lines.tts: [whispers, alarmed] Wait. There's someone by the gate. Sitting there.

lines.text: Wait. There's someone by the gate. Sitting there.
lines.tts: [whispers, alarmed] Wait. There's someone by the gate. Sitting there.

lines.speaker: Alex
lines.text: That's no survivor. Look at its arm. Look at the size of that arm.
lines.tts: [horrified] That's no survivor. Look at its arm... Look at the size of that arm!

lines.speaker: Aljay
lines.text: That's no survivor. Look at its arm. Look at the size of that arm.
lines.tts: [horrified] That's no survivor. Look at its arm... Look at the size of that arm!

lines.speaker: Ma'am Teves
lines.text: Diyos ko... Mang Dado? That's Mang Dado. He kept this gate. He locked it every night at nine.
lines.tts: [horrified] Diyos ko... Mang Dado? [voice breaking] That's Mang Dado. He kept this gate. He locked it every night, at nine.

lines.speaker: Alex
lines.text: That's not him any more. The others didn't do this. It's changed into something.
lines.tts: [grim] That's not him any more. The others didn't do this... It's changed into something.

lines.speaker: Aljay
lines.text: That's not him any more. The others didn't do this. It's changed into something.
lines.tts: [grim] That's not him any more. The others didn't do this... It's changed into something.

lines.tts: [grim] That's not him any more. The others didn't do this... It's changed into something.

lines.text: That's not him any more. The others didn't do this. It's changed into something.

lines.text: That's not him any more. The others didn't do this. It's changed into something.
lines.tts: [grim] That's not him any more. The others didn't do this... It's changed into something.

lines.speaker: Ma'am Teves
lines.text: The key... the gate's key is on his lanyard. It's still round his neck.
lines.tts: [realizing, quietly] The key... the gate's key is on his lanyard. It's still round his neck.

lines.speaker: Dodong Sikma
lines.text: I'm bitten. Please, I just want to go home. The soldiers went to the Olivar mart. None came back, but their equipment is still there. Stay with me.
lines.tts: [pained, weak] I'm bitten. Please... I just want to go home. The soldiers went to the Olivar mart. None came back... but their equipment is still there. [pleading] Stay with me.

lines.speaker: Dodong Sikma
lines.text: This is my house. I used to keep watch for the neighbourhood. My keys are beside the candle.
lines.tts: [tired relief] This is my house. I used to keep watch for the neighbourhood. My keys are beside the candle.

lines.speaker: Dodong Sikma
lines.text: Those are my gate keys. Leave me here. Take the north walk to the bridge, then the ramp. Go quietly up there. Hurry!
lines.tts: [weakly] Those are my gate keys. Leave me here. [coughs] Take the north walk to the bridge, then the ramp. Go quietly up there. [urgent] Hurry!

lines.speaker: Dodong Sikma
lines.text: The roof fell in. Hold C and follow me under. The plank bridge is just ahead.
lines.tts: [whispers, strained] The roof fell in. Crouch, and follow me under. The plank bridge is just ahead.

lines.text: Dodong didn't make it home.
lines.tts: [grave, quiet] Dodong didn't make it home.

lines.text: The back door gives way!
lines.tts: [tense] The back door gives way!

lines.speaker: Jonna
lines.text: Pssst! Hoy! Here, the office! Quick, before more of them come!
lines.tts: [loud whisper, frantic] Pssst! Hoy! Here! The office! Quick, before more of them come!

lines.speaker: Jonna
lines.text: Take it. The service gate key. Lock my door behind you. Go.
lines.tts: [pressing it into your hand] Take it. The service gate key. Lock my door behind you. [urgent] Go.

lines.speaker: Jonna
lines.text: Wait. Let me shut the front first. The light draws them.
lines.tts: [nervous] Wait, wait. Let me shut the front first. The light draws them.

lines.speaker: Jonna
lines.text: There. Nothing comes through that now.
lines.tts: [out of breath, relieved] There. Nothing comes through that now.

lines.speaker: Rommel
lines.text: Hoy... hoy! Over here, by the gate! Don't shoot... I'm not one of them!
lines.tts: [hoarse, desperate] Hoy... hoy! Over here, by the gate! Don't shoot! [panicked] I'm not one of them!

lines.speaker: Rommel
lines.text: It's open. The main doors are at the end of the covered walk. Fifth floor, west side. Go!
lines.tts: [straining, urgent] It's open! The main doors are at the end of the covered walk. Fifth floor, west side. Go!

lines.text: Both stairs up are piled with desks. Someone wrote on the wall: FIRE EXIT, EAST END.
lines.tts: [low, ominous] Both stairs up are piled with desks. Someone wrote on the wall... Fire exit. East end.

lines.text: Both stairs are blocked again. A note says the janitor's ladder goes up.
lines.tts: [low] Both stairs are blocked again. A note says... the janitor's ladder goes up.

lines.text: Somewhere down this corridor someone is knocking. Three times, then nothing.
lines.tts: [hushed, eerie] Somewhere down this corridor, someone is knocking. Three times... [pause] then nothing.

lines.speaker: Rommel
lines.text: I've got the gate. Go! Don't wait for me!
lines.tts: [shouting over the noise] I've got the gate! Go! Don't wait for me!

lines.speaker: Dodong Sikma
lines.text: This is my house. My keys are beside the candle.
lines.tts: [tired relief] This is my house. My keys are beside the candle.

lines.speaker: Room 501
lines.text: The desks behind the door scrape aside. A teacher in a maroon blazer, and four students behind her.
lines.tts: [hushed] The desks behind the door scrape aside. A teacher in a maroon blazer... and four students behind her.

lines.speaker: Ma'am Teves
lines.text: Inside. Lights off. Here they come.
lines.tts: [whispers urgently] Inside. Lights off. Here they come.

lines.speaker: Ma'am Teves
lines.text: Inside! Now! I can hear them on the stairs!
lines.tts: [panicked whisper] Inside! Now! I can hear them on the stairs!

lines.speaker: Ma'am Teves
lines.text: That's the east stairs. Don't. Move.
lines.tts: [barely a whisper] That's the east stairs. Don't. Move.

lines.text: The chain slides off the push bar. Cold air. The fire escape goes all the way down.
lines.tts: [quiet tension] The chain slides off the push bar. Cold air. The fire escape goes all the way down.

lines.speaker: Ma'am Teves
lines.text: The gas! The kitchen's gas store! Hold on to something!
lines.tts: [screaming] The gas! The kitchen's gas store! Hold on to something!

lines.speaker: Paolo
lines.text: Ma'am, look: the stairs are gone! There's smoke coming out of 208... the wall's gone, there's a roof under it!
lines.tts: [panicked, shouting] Ma'am, look, the stairs are gone! There's smoke coming out of two-oh-eight... the wall's gone! There's a roof under it!

lines.text: The field. The blast brought them all out here, and they've heard you. The rear gate is at the far end.
lines.tts: [grave, urgent] The field. The blast brought them all out here... and they've heard you. The rear gate is at the far end.

lines.speaker: Alex
lines.text: It went up right on him! Again, find another drum!
lines.tts: [shouting, fired up] It went up right on him! Again! Find another drum!

lines.tts: [shouting, fired up] It went up right on him! Again! Find another drum!

lines.tts: [shouting, fired up] It went up right on him! Again! Find another drum!

lines.speaker: Alex
lines.text: Behind us! They're coming up behind us!
lines.tts: [yelling, panicked] Behind us! They're coming up behind us!

lines.text: Behind us! They're coming up behind us!

lines.text: It's down... it's over. The key, there, on the ground. Take it, open the gate!

lines.tts: [out of breath] Got it! The rear gate's key... still on the guard's ring.

lines.text: The padlock opens; the chain rattles down. The gate swings out onto the street.
lines.tts: [relief, quiet] The padlock opens... the chain rattles down. The gate swings out onto the street.

lines.text: The whole team is down.
lines.tts: [grave] The whole team is down.

lines.speaker: Hooded man
lines.text: You have to hurry!
lines.tts: [out of breath, urgent] You have to hurry!

lines.speaker: Hooded man
lines.text: Your wife and 2 daughters are with the association, so you can breathe easy.
lines.tts: [calmer, reassuring] Your wife and two daughters are with the association... so you can breathe easy.

lines.speaker: Hooded man
lines.text: Now, I have to give you something. Please follow me.
lines.tts: [serious] Now... I have to give you something. Please, follow me.

lines.speaker: Hooded man
lines.text: Now, take these with you and go back! Hurry, before they notice!
lines.tts: [frantic] Now, take these with you and go back! Hurry, before they notice!

lines.speaker: You
lines.text: Hello? ...Nobody.
lines.tts: [calling softly] Hello?... [uneasy] Nobody.

lines.speaker: You
lines.text: Padlocked. From the outside.
lines.tts: [quietly, uneasy] Padlocked. From the outside.

lines.speaker: You
lines.text: Something moved in there. Or I imagined it.
lines.tts: [tense whisper] Something moved in there. [nervous breath] Or I imagined it.

lines.speaker: You
lines.text: It smells like something died behind this door.
lines.tts: [disgusted, gagging] It smells like something died behind this door.

lines.speaker: You
lines.text: Locked. A wet rag is stuffed under it.
lines.tts: Locked. [puzzled] A wet rag is stuffed under it.

lines.speaker: You
lines.text: Someone sprayed a number on it. A census mark... or a warning.
lines.tts: Someone sprayed a number on it. A census mark... [ominous] or a warning.

lines.speaker: You
lines.text: I can hear dripping inside.
lines.tts: [whispers] I can hear dripping inside.

lines.speaker: You
lines.text: Locked. Good.
lines.tts: [relieved exhale] Locked. Good.

lines.speaker: You
lines.text: I guess no one's home..
lines.tts: [sighs] I guess no one's home...

lines.speaker: You
lines.text: Hello? ...Anyone there?
lines.tts: [calling out, hesitant] Hello?... [quieter] Anyone there?

lines.speaker: You
lines.text: Locked. No answer, either.
lines.tts: Locked. [uneasy] No answer, either.

lines.speaker: You
lines.text: Someone used to live here. Where did everybody go?
lines.tts: [sad, quiet] Someone used to live here. Where did everybody go?

lines.speaker: You
lines.text: I thought I heard something inside.
lines.tts: [nervous whisper] I thought I heard something inside.

lines.speaker: You
lines.text: No lights. Not a sound.
lines.tts: [quietly] No lights. Not a sound.

lines.speaker: You
lines.text: Maybe I should leave this one alone.
lines.tts: [uneasy] Maybe I should leave this one alone.

lines.speaker: You
lines.text: Shit..
lines.tts: [shocked, under his breath] Shit...

lines.speaker: You
lines.text: I thought this place was empty decades ago?
lines.tts: [disturbed] I thought this place was empty... decades ago?

lines.speaker: You
lines.text: Chained shut.
lines.tts: [frustrated] Chained shut.

lines.speaker: You
lines.text: That padlock is new.
lines.tts: [suspicious] That padlock is new.

lines.speaker: You
lines.text: Someone comes down here.
lines.tts: [ominous whisper] Someone comes down here.

lines.speaker: You
lines.text: I've never been inside of the Nichols property..
lines.tts: [nervous, hushed] I've never been inside of the Nichols property...

lines.speaker: You
lines.text: It's.. locked? Weird.
lines.tts: [confused] It's... locked? [puzzled] Weird.

lines.speaker: You
lines.text: The roof's caved in. I'll have to crouch to get under.
lines.tts: [grunts] The roof's caved in. I'll have to crouch to get under.

callouts.I'm out! I'm out of ammo!: [panicked] I'm out! I'm out of ammo!
[low, focused] Hold here. Watch the corners.
callouts.I'm down! Somebody help me!: [screaming in pain] I'm down! Somebody help me!
[relieved, breathless] Thanks, I owe you one.
callouts.Grenade out! Fire in the hole!: [shouting] Grenade out! Fire in the hole!
callouts.Fire in the hole! Get down!: [urgent yell] Fire in the hole! Get down!
